title: English Practice Quiz 0973
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: An agenda is a list of ___.
options: items to be discussed at a meeting
questions.explanation: An agenda outlines the subjects planned for discussion.

questions.question: The minutes of a meeting are ___.
options: the official written record of discussion and decisions
questions.explanation: Meeting minutes record key discussions, decisions and actions.

questions.question: A document marked 'draft' is ___.
options: not yet in its final form
questions.explanation: A draft is a preliminary version that may be revised.

questions.question: To 'file' a document means to ___.
options: organise and store it for reference
questions.explanation: Filing keeps documents organised and retrievable.

questions.question: Which subject line suits an email requesting leave approval?
questions.explanation: A specific subject line tells the recipient what the email concerns.

questions.question: A 'duplicate' document is ___.
options: an additional copy of the same document
questions.explanation: Duplicate means a copy or something repeated.

questions.question: Before sending an attachment, you should check that it is ___.
questions.explanation: Checking the attachment prevents accidental sharing of the wrong document.

questions.question: A 'dispatch' register records items that have been ___.
questions.explanation: Dispatch records track outgoing documents or goods.

questions.question: Which phrase politely asks for confirmation of receipt?
options: Please confirm that you have received this email.
questions.explanation: This is a clear and professional confirmation request.
